sourceTitle: Pasta With Cream Sauce and Mushrooms
sourceText:
Pasta With Cream Sauce and Mushrooms
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 27, 2009 - 11:44pm

Ingredients




1 tablespoon olive oil
2 tablespoons chopped onions
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 teaspoon oregano
1/4 teaspoon dried thyme
1/4 teaspoon dried rosemary
1/4 cup white wine
1 2/3 cups soymilk
1/4 cup margarine
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon white pepper
1 bay leaf
1/4 cup flour
2 cups fresh vegetables*, cut into small
small cut into  pieces
1 pound pasta, cooked

Preparation

1 * (Try broccoli, mushrooms, cauliflower, and zucchini) 2 In a large saucepan, heat the olive oil over low heat. Add the onion and garlic, and saute until tender. Add the oregano, thyme, and rosemary, and saute a few minutes more. Add the wine and bring to a boil. 3 Add the soymilk, margarine, salt, pepper-and bay leaf. Return the mixture to a boil, stirring occasionally until the margarine melts. Add the flour a tablespoon at a time, whisking after each addition to avoid lumps. Stir until the mixture thickens, about 2 minutes. 4 Place the vegetables in a steamer or metal sieve over boiling water and steam until just tender. To serve, toss the vegetables with the freshly cooked pasta. Pour the sauce over the pasta and vegetables, and toss to mix. 5 Yield 4servings.
